settings.heading: The day
settings.text: The book, the letter, the lipstick, the keys. Room for all of it, and for the walk home.

settings.body:
I have been thinking about what a woman keeps close. Not the performance of a bag — the actual contents. The letter she means to post. The paperback with the corner turned down. The lipstick she will reapply in a doorway, badly, and not mind.

In Her Purse is that thought, made into a collection. It begins with the Brownstone Tote. Brown suede, a scarf I would not take off, and enough room to leave the house without a plan.

settings.heading: When you may carry it
settings.text: The Brownstone Tote opens the debut. Leave an address and the house will write when it is ready — and when the next piece of In Her Purse appears.
